meta.name: talent-utilization-framework
meta.description: Use when building a leadership team, delegating authority, or evaluating why leaders succeed or fail. Applies Liu Bang's talent utilization model (用人之道) with Zhang Liang, Xiao He, and Han Xin.

copy.tagline: 评估领导团队的人才配置与授权模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要评估或优化领导团队的人才结构与授权方式。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate talent allocation and delegation patterns in leadership teams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate or optimize talent structure and delegation in your leadership team.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你评估领导者的用人之道：分析是否覆盖战略、后勤、执行三大领域，判断自我认知、授权和奖励分配是否合理，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你寻求建设领导团队、授权他人，或分析某位领导者（包括自己）成功或失败的原因时触发。

say.text: 请用刘邦用人之道框架，分析我团队的战略、后勤、执行能力。
say.note: Claude 会逐一评估并指出短板。

say.text: 帮我检查我在授权时是否给予了专家足够信任？
say.note: Claude 会对照框架中避免微管理的要点。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can help you evaluate a leader's talent utilization based on Liu Bang's model: analyze coverage of strategy, logistics, and execution; assess self-awareness, delegation, and reward sharing; and suggest improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about building a leadership team, delegating authority, or evaluating why a leader (including yourself) succeeds or fails.

say_en.text: Analyze my team's strategy, logistics, and execution using Liu Bang's framework.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate each area and identify gaps.

say_en.text: Check if I delegate enough trust to experts in their domains.
say_en.note: Claude will compare against the framework's anti-micromanagement points.
